problems.title: Palindrome Number
problems.description: Write a Python program to check whether a number is a palindrome.
problems.code:
num=int(input("Enter Number: "))
original=num
rev=0

while num>0:
    digit=num%10
    rev=rev*10+digit
    num//=10

if original==rev:
    print("Palindrome Number")
else:
    print("Not a Palindrome Number")

problems.title: Armstrong Number
problems.description: Write a Python program to check whether a number is an Armstrong number.
problems.code:
num=int(input("Enter Number: "))
original=num
power=len(str(num))
sum=0

while num>0:
    digit=num%10
    sum+=digit**power
    num//=10

if sum==original:
    print("Armstrong Number")
else:
    print("Not an Armstrong Number")
